title: Young and proud
creator_credit: Leah Latham, ACMI Digital Storytelling and ACMI
brief_description: A young, successful and proud Yamatji woman, Leah Latham attributes the person she is today to growing up with different cultures. She acknowledges it can be hard being a mix of English and Indigenous cultures, but believes it has also made her the person she is today.
